parameters.name: coverage_indicator
parameters.description: Binary indicator of whether shift start s covers period t

parameters.name: num_shift_starts
parameters.description: Number of allowed shift start times

parameters.name: shift_starts
parameters.description: Allowed shift start times indexed by shift start

variables.name: staff_assigned_by_shift
variables.description: Integer number of salespeople assigned to start each shift

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_staff_assignments
constraints.description: The number of salespeople assigned to each shift start is a nonnegative integer.

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_total_scheduled_salespeople
constraints.description: The total number of scheduled salespeople is a nonnegative integer.

constraints.name: binary_coverage_indicator
constraints.description: Coverage indicators are binary values indicating whether a shift starting at s covers period t.

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_demand
constraints.description: Period demand is nonnegative and integer-valued for each period.

constraints.name: period_partition_structure
constraints.description: The planning horizon is partitioned into T equal periods of length Delta.

constraints.name: shift_start_restriction
constraints.description: Salespeople may only start at allowed shift start times.
constraints.formula: x_s \text{ is defined only for } s \in \{0,\dots,S-1\}

constraints.name: fixed_shift_duration
constraints.description: Each salesperson assigned to a shift works continuously for the full shift duration.
constraints.formula: \text{Each shift assigned to } x_s \text{ lasts for } L \text{ time units}

constraints.name: coverage_requirement
constraints.description: Every period must receive staffing coverage sufficient to meet or exceed demand.

constraints.name: coverage_indicator_semantics
constraints.description: A shift assignment covers a period whenever the corresponding coverage indicator equals 1.

constraints.name: shift_wraparound_possible
constraints.description: Shifts may extend beyond the end of the planning horizon if needed.
constraints.formula: \text{Coverage is allowed for periods beyond } H \text{ when a shift extends past the horizon end}

constraints.name: staffing_coverage_constraint
constraints.description: Each period must be staffed to at least its required demand using the assigned shift coverage indicators.

constraints.name: total_salespeople_definition
constraints.description: The total scheduled workforce equals the sum of the assigned staff across all allowed shift starts.

objectives.name: minimize_total_scheduled_salespeople
objectives.description: Minimize the total number of scheduled salespeople while satisfying all period staffing requirements

final_objective.description: Minimize the total number of scheduled salespeople by minimizing the scalar total workforce variable Z; this is a single-objective MILP, so no combination strategy is needed.
